THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 439 OF CR.P.C., PRAYING TO ALLOW THE PETITION, THEREBY ENLARGE THE PETITIONERS ON BAIL IN CRIME NO.199/2023 REGISTERED FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTIONS 498-A AND 306 READ WITH SECTION 34 OF IPC AS PER FIR REGISTERED BY HUMNABAD POLICE STATION DISTRICT BIDAR, NOW PENDING ON THE FILE OF PRL. CIVIL JUDGE (JR.DN) AND JMFC COURT, HUMNABAD.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This petition is filed by the petitioners - accused Nos.1 to 3 under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for granting bail in Crime No.199/2023 registered by Humnabad Police Station, District Bidar, for the offences punishable under Sections 498-A and 306 read with Section 34 of IPC, pending on the file of Prl.
Civil Judge (Jr. Dn) and JMFC Court, at Humnabad.

The case of the prosecution is that on the complaint of one Venkat the father of the deceased - Kaveri, the police have registered the FIR on 14.09.2023 alleging that his daughter had married to the petitioner No.1 about 7 - 8 years back and it was love marriage.
After the marriage a female child was born to them.
Thereafter, the accused No.1 to 3 have said to be harassing her physically and mentally stating that she is not looking fair, not doing household work and preparing good food.
Due to which, she is said to be committed suicide by jumping into the well on 13.09.2023.

After Ramesh And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka on 15 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57133739/
2 registering the FIR, the police have arrested these petitioners on 15.09.2023 and they are in judicial custody.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: They have approached to the learned Sessions Judge for granting bail, the same is came to be rejected.
Hence, they are before this Court.
03. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent - State.

Upon hearing the arguments and on perusal of the records it reveals that of course the death is because of suicide is not in dispute, which was committed by the deceased by jumping into the well,
after 7 - 8 years of her marriage.
The accused No.4 is said to be granted anticipatory bail by the learned Sessions Judge.
These petitioners are in judicial custody for more than 02 months.
The investigation is likely to be completed within short period.
The alleged offences are though non-bailable, but not punishable with death or imprisonment for life, but it is triable by the learned Sessions Judge.

The allegations against these petitioners are that they are abusing the deceased that she is not looking fair, not preparing good food and not doing household work, but the same shall be construed as an abatement or not as per Section 107 of IPC, which is pending investigation that has to be collect the evidence by the Investigating Officer while filing the charge-sheet.
NC: 2023:KHC-K:8596 05.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that, on imposing certain stringent conditions, if bail is granted to the petitioners, no prejudice will be caused to the prosecution.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following;
ORDER
The petition filed by petitioner is allowed.
